_mode: auto | linux | windows. auto = windows under WSL. Override: --windows / --linux.
_windows: Windows mode: CPU from Energy Meter counter if present, else cpu_idle_w..cpu_max_w scaled by CPU utilisation.
_lhm: Optional: run LibreHardwareMonitor (admin) with Remote Web Server on for real CPU Package watts. Empty lhm_url disables it.
_rest: Motherboard, RAM, SSDs, fans, USB: no sensor, fixed estimate (W, DC side).
_rest_dyn: Board/RAM/SSD/fans rise from rest_idle_w to rest_load_w as CPU+GPU power reaches rest_ref_w. Estimates, no sensor exists.
_psu: Wall power = DC power / efficiency. ~0.87 for an 80+ Gold PSU at low load.
_psu_curve: Chieftec Proton BDF-750C, 80 PLUS Bronze. No measured data for this unit: Bronze minimums (~82/85/82% at 20/50/100% load) plus a typical drop below 10% load. Pairs are [fraction of psu_rated_w, efficiency].
_monitors: Matched by EDID model name. on_w_min/on_w_max are scaled by DDC brightness when it can be read; otherwise on_w_max is used.
